text:
adele: quick standup thread - we need to pick the observability cut for the beta. two clear asks: finance wants invoice-ready exports, ML wants fast regression alerts tied to model rollouts. can we land one coherent v1 slice that minimizes infra risk?

harry: short take: ship route-cost dashboards + lightweight regression signals. dashboards unblock finance quickly, regression signals give ML teams early warning. keep traces off by default; sample on-alert.

noah: agree. concrete v1 scope proposal:
- per-route cost table (top 25 routes) + CSV export for tenants (marked ESTIMATED)
- regression detector (model.version vs baseline) running in background, emits alerts to slack + incidents when stat-sig uplift in error-rate
- trace-on-alert: when regression or error spike alert fires, capture up to 20 full traces for the alert window

meera: sampling & perf constraints: propose
```
tracing.global=0.001 # 0.1% baseline
tracing.on_alert=1.0 # 100% when alerting
anomaly.window=5m
regression.alpha=0.01
```
This keeps steady-state storage low while giving context for incidents.

harry: acceptance criteria for beta v1 (must pass):
- CSV export with allocation metadata and "estimated" badge
- regression alerts include model.version, delta %, p-value, and link to sampled traces if available
- canary perf: p95 latency impact <3% and infra cost projection delta <=12% for beta cohort
- rollback toggle to disable tracing instantly per-tenant

ops-bot: staging bench: 50k rps simulated -> tracing.global=0.001 yields ~18GB/day trace volume; p95 +1.9%. on_alert sampling adds ~6GB/day for canary cohort. Ticket created: https://tracker/redwood/PRD-998

meera: engineering asks: 2 backend (aggregations + regression runner), 1 infra for perf & canary automation, 1 frontend for CSV + dashboard templates. estimate 3 sprints to deliver canary. need a small synthetic harness to validate false-positive rate.

adele: rollout plan: internal canary 5% for 10 days -> monitor alerts/day, p95, and allocation uncertainty -> expand to 25% if stable. customer comms: will mark tenant CSVs as "estimated" in docs.

noah: one more UX note: include an "explain allocation" modal that shows the heuristic and a percent uncertainty score so finance knows limitations.

adele: ok locking this as the v1 cut unless objections. i'll add the acceptance checklist to the roadmap item and tag the tracker ticket. speak now or i lock at EOD. :lock:
